# Adeline

A desktop app for working with coding agents. Adeline keeps your chats, project docs and local services in one window.

## Start

```bash
cargo build --release --locked
./target/release/adeline
```

Run `adeline --demo` to try it with sample projects and no agent.

## Read next

- [Architecture](docs/architecture.md)
- [Viewer feature tour](docs/markdown-guide.md)
- [Current plan](notes/plan.md)
demo-adeline.docs/architecture.md:
# Architecture

Adeline has two parts: the desktop UI and the engine. They talk over a local socket with JSON messages.

## UI

The UI draws chats, docs and settings. It holds no agent state. Every change comes from the engine as an event.

## Engine

The engine runs agents, stores chats and watches project files. One engine serves one machine. A UI can connect to engines on other machines.

## A message, end to end

1. The user sends a message from the composer.
2. The UI sends `Send` to the engine.
3. The engine starts or resumes the agent and streams its reply back as events.
4. When the agent edits a doc, the engine adds a card to the reply.

See [diagrams](diagrams.md) for the same flow as a picture.

# Viewer feature tour

This page uses every Markdown feature the Docs Viewer supports. Open it after a change to the Viewer and check each section. Jump to [saving and reloading](#saving-and-reloading), or read [the plan](../notes/plan.md) for what comes next.

![badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/demo-ok-green)

## Text

Plain text with **bold**, *italic*, ~~struck out~~ and `inline code`. A bare link becomes clickable: https://example.com. The Viewer opens it in the browser.

Docs keeps files on disk as they are.[^1] It never rewrites line endings.[^2]

## Lists

### Bullets

- Chats
- Docs
  - Viewer
  - Editor
    - Source mode
- Services

### Numbered

1. Open a project.
2. Press the Docs shortcut.
3. Pick a file in the tree.
   1. Folders expand with the right arrow.
   2. Enter opens the file.

### Tasks

- [x] Render front matter as a table
- [x] Highlight fenced code
- [ ] Scroll to a heading from an anchor link
- [ ] Show a missing image as a placeholder

## Table

| Shortcut | Action | Mode |
| --- | --- | :---: |
| Ctrl+S | Save the doc | Docs |
| Ctrl+K | Jump to a chat | Chats |
| Ctrl+P | Find a doc | Docs |

## Code

Rust:

```rust
fn slug(heading: &str) -> String {
    heading
        .to_lowercase()
        .chars()
        .filter(|c| c.is_alphanumeric() || *c == ' ' || *c == '-')
        .map(|c| if c == ' ' { '-' } else { c })
        .collect()
}
```

JSON:

```json
{
  "entity": "adeline://docs/notes/plan.md",
  "title": "plan.md",
  "gone": false
}
```

Bash:

```bash
cargo build --release --locked
./target/release/adeline --demo
```

## Images

A local image by relative path. The file is not in the demo, so it shows as missing:

![diagram](images/overview.png)

## Alerts

> [!NOTE]
> The Viewer reads the file again when it changes on disk.

> [!TIP]
> Press Ctrl+P to find a doc by name.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Save before you switch projects if you want the change on disk now.

> [!WARNING]
> Files over 10 MB open read-only.

> [!CAUTION]
> Taking the version on disk drops your unsaved edits.

## Saving and reloading

#### When the file changes on disk

A doc with no unsaved edits reloads by itself. A doc with unsaved edits asks you to keep your version or take the one on disk.

#### When you close the project

Adeline asks you to save all, discard, or cancel.

[^1]: Except when you save. Then only the lines you changed are written.
[^2]: A CRLF file stays CRLF.
demo-adeline.docs/diagrams.md:
# Diagrams

One small diagram of each type the Viewer renders. The last one has a syntax error on purpose.

## Flowchart

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    UI[Desktop UI] -->|request| Engine
    Engine -->|prompt| Agent
    Agent -->|reply| Engine
    Engine -->|events| UI
```

## Sequence

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant U as User
    participant E as Engine
    participant A as Agent
    U->>E: Send message
    E->>A: Prompt
    A-->>E: Reply chunks
    E-->>U: Streamed reply
```

## Class

```mermaid
classDiagram
    class Workspace {
        +String id
        +Vec~Thread~ threads
    }
    class Thread {
        +String title
        +Vec~Card~ cards
    }
    class Card {
        +String entity
        +bool gone
    }
    Workspace "1" --> "*" Thread
    Thread "1" --> "*" Card
```

## State

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Idle
    Idle --> Processing: send
    Processing --> Attention: needs input
    Attention --> Processing: answer
    Processing --> Idle: done
    Idle --> [*]
```

## Entity relationship

```mermaid
erDiagram
    PROJECT ||--o{ CHAT : has
    CHAT ||--o{ MESSAGE : contains
    CHAT ||--o{ CARD : shows
    PROJECT {
        string id
        string name
    }
    CARD {
        string entity
        int edited
    }
```

## Gantt

```mermaid
gantt
    title Docs mode
    dateFormat YYYY-MM-DD
    section Viewer
    Markdown       :done, v1, 2026-09-01, 10d
    Mermaid        :active, v2, after v1, 7d
    section Editor
    Source editing :e1, after v2, 10d
    Outside changes :e2, after e1, 5d
```

## Pie

```mermaid
pie title Docs by type
    "Markdown" : 9
    "YAML" : 1
    "TOML" : 1
    "Text" : 1
```

## Broken

This block has a syntax error, so the Viewer shows its source and a note.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A[Start --> B{Missing bracket
    B -->> C
```
demo-adeline.docs/scopes/scope-search.md:
Status: Draft

# Search in long chats

## Problem

Searching a chat with a large tool log pauses the window for up to a second.

## Requirements

- R1. Typing in the search field never blocks drawing.
- R2. Results update within 100 ms for a chat of 50,000 lines.
- R3. Clearing the field restores the scroll position.

## Out of scope

Search across projects.
demo-adeline.docs/scopes/scope-session-restore.md:
Status: Confirmed

# Session restore

Adeline reopens each project as the user left it: the selected chat, the open doc, panel sizes and scroll position.

## Requirements

- R1. Restore happens per project.
- R2. A missing doc opens the project home.
- R3. A damaged session file falls back to the default layout and never blocks startup.

demo-relay.README.md:
# relay-server

Receives webhooks and delivers them to configured destinations, with retries.
demo-relay.docs/retries.md:
# Retries

A failed delivery is retried after 1, 5 and 30 minutes. After the third failure the message goes to the dead letter queue.

| Attempt | Delay |
| --- | --- |
| 1 | 1 min |
| 2 | 5 min |
| 3 | 30 min |
demo-relay.config/relay.yaml:
listen: 0.0.0.0:8080
retry:
  delays_s: [60, 300, 1800]
dead_letter:
  path: /var/lib/relay/dead
log:
  level: info
  request_ids: true
